name: Monkeytype
tagline: The typing test, offline — personal bests live in the file, one invite is a live race.
description:
No account. It works on a plane. Your history and personal bests stay inside this GIF, and the invite link is a live race with no server.

Words or a quote appear. Type. A yellow caret follows you. Speed is characters you got right, five to a word; accuracy sits next to it. Time 15 / 30 / 60 / 120, or a set number of words, or a quote. Punctuation and numbers if you want them. Themes without downloading a font. Tab restarts. Escape opens commands.

Press race a friend, then Invite in the bar above the app, and send the link. Everyone gets the same words. Live bars. Highest WPM when the clock hits zero — or first to finish a words/quote test — wins.

An unofficial port of Monkeytype by Miodec. The original needs the site and an account to keep a record. This copy keeps the test and puts the record in the file.
